handedness_evidence: User confirmed left hand, unmirrored in this chat.
mapping: No image/landmark reflection. Fit proper wrist rotations and robot joint constraints later.
time_basis: Seconds relative to first original video PTS; sampled visual review at approximately 0.25 s intervals.

phases.name: approach_preshape
phases.hand_visibility: Increasingly visible; wrist/forearm enter from left

phases.name: acquisition_occluded

phases.object_visibility: Pen shaft/end segments visible, contact region hidden

phases.name: lift_and_wrist_rotation
phases.hand_visibility: Wrist rolls from dorsum view toward palm view
phases.object_visibility: Pen becomes increasingly visible; exact liftoff not verified

phases.name: held_presentation
phases.object_visibility: Most of pen visible; grasp interface still partly hidden

object_axis_observations.coordinate_system: 480x854 image; x right, y down; zero-based

color_review.comparison: Explicit HLG-to-SDR Hable produces a stronger orange cast; original decode retains usable hand/object detail
color_review.calibration: Visual preference only; no measured color reference

uncertainties: Exact finger contact and liftoff times are not visible
